findings.body: The standard requires modules to use another module through its exported service, “never through its repository, tables or internal files.” The SDK client imports the Postgres implementation and resolves global runtime storage itself; that implementation directly imports storage repositories and schema. This also contradicts the approved boundary requiring the factory to inject TeamsConversationRouteStore and prohibiting Postgres imports in the SDK client. Inject the existing store interface from the factory so transport authentication and delivery remain independent of persistence construction.
findings.title: Standard: Module boundaries
